rows.role_title: State President of the Republic of South Africa
rows.text: Government Notice No. 1820 of 16 August 1989 (State President's Office) notifies that Pieter Willem Botha vacated the office of State President of the Republic of South Africa with effect from 15 August 1989.

locator.item: Government Notice No. 1820, first paragraph (English left column; Afrikaans right)

rows.role_title: Acting State President of the Republic of South Africa
rows.text: The same notice states that the remaining members of the Cabinet designated Frederik Willem de Klerk as Acting State President on 15 August 1989 under section 10(2)(c) of the Republic of South Africa Constitution Act, 1983, and that he made and subscribed the oath of office of Acting State President and assumed that office, with all its powers, duties and functions, on 15 August 1989.

locator.item: Government Notice No. 1820, both paragraphs (English left column; Afrikaans right)
